reviews.body:
### 🟢 Approval recommended The focused fix preserves existing capture behavior and includes regression coverage for both streaming wrappers, with no blocking issues identified. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR Fixes missing refusal text in OpenAI streamed chat-completion telemetry, matching the existing non-streaming behavior. **Changes:** - Buffers refusal deltas and emits them as a text part. - Adds buffer and sync/async streaming regression tests. - Records the fix in the changelog. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | instrumentation/​opentelemetry-instrumentation-genai-openai/​tests/​test_choice_buffer.py | Tests refusal accumulation. | | instrumentation/​opentelemetry-instrumentation-genai-openai/​tests/​test_chat_stream_refusal.py | Tests sync/async refusal capture. | | instrumentation/​opentelemetry-instrumentation-genai-openai/​src/​opentelemetry/​instrumentation/​genai/​openai/​chat_wrappers.py | Captures refusal deltas in output messages. | | instrumentation/​opentelemetry-instrumentation-genai-openai/​src/​opentelemetry/​instrumentation/​genai/​openai/​chat_buffers.py | Adds per-choice refusal buffering. | | instrumentation/​opentelemetry-instrumentation-genai-openai/​.changelog/​907.fixed | Documents the fix. |
Review effort: Balanced

Looks good to me, thanks @pcbeingused333 

I've left one suggstion for updating a test to check the exported span not just the in-memory messages.

LGTM. This makes streaming record refusals the same way non-streaming already does.

We'll probably need to change how refusals are reported. Plain text parts make a refused answer look like a normal one, and I opened https://github.com/open-telemetry/semantic-conventions-genai/issues/609 to sort that out. Accepting this PR until that issue is settled.

review_comments.body:
This asserts the in-memory `output_messages` rather than what actually lands on the span.

Asserting the recorded output on the span would be better and would catch a future change that breaks the serialisation.
Done in 77d0a3e, the test now reads `gen_ai.output.messages` from the exported span (with content capture on), and it still fails without the fix.
